_meta.description: Generic effect phrase library for query generation. Slot-level only — no card IDs. Placeholders {amount}, {p}, {t}, {keyword}, {token}, {color} filled at compose time.
_meta.composition_rule: Pick one trigger phrase + one effect phrase + one target phrase per binding. Effect phrases describe the action only; targeting lives in targets.json, numbers in amounts.json.
_meta.card_mapping: Per-card effect bindings live in parsed_cards.jsonl (parser output), not in this library.

placeholders.stat: source statistic phrase selected from EQUAL_POWER or EQUAL_TOUGHNESS
placeholders.token: token stat line e.g. 4/4 red Dragon

_meta.candidate_render_note: candidate_render is for synthetic card text only. Existing phrases remain the query-generation phrase pool. Candidate templates must contain the complete effect wording needed for composition, while target and numeric values remain placeholders; do not copy query shorthand or append duration wording here.
